duties.title: Early Game
duties.description: As an Explorer, you will start the game by planning your route and purchasing necessary items. Once the gates are open, you will be able to earn "Explorers" experience by entering unexplored areas of the map. Additionally, you are able to find relics by slaying Faithless.

duties.title: Mid Game
duties.description: As you continue to explore the island, you will occasionally find yourself in direct combat with opposing factions. As an Explorer, your job is ideally to avoid combat and continue to explore the island.

duties.title: Late Game
duties.description: Once the Island has been explored, it is time to utilize the knowledge you have gained to help your faction win. As an Explorer, you will typically be ahead of your allies in terms of raw power. This means that you will be able to take on more difficult challenges and help your allies secure clash points and expand your influence on the Island.
